test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If tan A = (2)/(5) find the value of (sec ² A)/(operatorname{cosec)² A}.
solution:
**Given:**

tan A = 2/5

**Formula used:**

tan A = opposite/adjacent (sin A/cos A)

sec² A = 1 + tan² A

cosec² A = 1 + cot² A = 1 + (1/tan² A)

**Calculation:**

tan A = 2/5

sec2 A = 1 + tan2 A = 1 + (2/5)² = 1 + 4/25 = 29/25

cot A = 1/tan A = 5/2, so cosec2 A = 1 + cot2 A + (5/2)² = 1 + 25/4 = 29/4

Value = sec² A / cosec² A = (29/25) / (29/4) = (29/25) × (4/29) = 4/25

**So, the value is 4/25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

(sec ² A)/(operatorname{cosec)² A} = (1/cos²A)/(1/sin²A)

⇒ (Sin²A/Cos²A)

⇒ tan²A = (2/5)² = 4/25

**∴ The value is 4/25. **
